calibration_provenance.decision_reason: NO model-specific pair. Gemma proceeds common-arm only because all 30 frozen calibration outputs were malformed under the frozen strict parser. No parser relaxation, prompt change, or rerun was used.

gemma.model_specific_arm_reason: Calibration produced 0/30 parser-valid outputs under the frozen strict `^Choice:\s*([12])\s*$` parser; raw generations were bare "1"/"2". No parser relaxation and no rerun were used, so no preference matrix exists and no pair can be selected. Frozen rule: common arm only (§20.2, §34).

calibration_provenance.decision_reason: NO model-specific pair. Mistral proceeds common-arm only because the measured top source was "a government website", but the three least-preferred sources tied and their direct comparisons were order-unstable, so choosing one as the dispreferred source would require an unprespecified post-hoc tie-break.

mistral.model_specific_arm_reason: Calibration produced no defensible prespecified dispreferred source: the bottom three sources tied at 2/10 and the direct low-tier comparisons were 1:1, so the ordering is unstable. Forcing a pair would invent a contrast the calibration does not support. Frozen rule: common arm only (§20.2, §34).

screening.candidate_item_ids_scope: the screened prefix of the frozen §9 primary-relation candidate frame; all four models screened exactly this set of candidates
